definition.description: Stores user profiles. The 'userId' parameter corresponds to the Firebase Auth UID.

params.name: userId
params.description: The unique identifier for the user, matching the Firebase Auth UID.

definition.description: A global collection of all notas from all users. Access is controlled by security rules based on ownership and roles.

params.name: notaId
params.description: The unique identifier for the nota.

firestore.reasoning: The data is structured with a top-level `users` collection for profiles and a top-level `notas` collection for all user-generated notes. This flat structure for `notas` simplifies querying, allowing all users to view all notes easily, which aligns with the application's requirements. Security is enforced within the rules: while reads are permissive, writes (create, update, delete) are strictly controlled. A user can only create a nota with their own `userId`, and can only update or delete notas they own. Admins are granted special privileges to update any nota for verification purposes. This design is efficient and secure for the specified use case.
